scenarios.prompt: Use the pinned concept image `assets/concepts/enemies-and-oval-arena.png` only as cosmetic sample material. Define what would have to be isolated into atlas slots or palette variants before a skin swap could be validated without changing gameplay geometry.

criteria.ownership: Cosmetic swaps do not own hitbox/hurtbox geometry, collision filters, stats or cancel timing.
criteria.fallback: Missing attachments use a published visual fallback while logical body state remains intact.
criteria.evidence: Compare gameplay geometry/timing before and after the swap; do not claim fairness without that evidence.
